description: This file defines a class for managing the context of large language model (LLM) interactions, including message history, multimedia content, and tool configurations. It also includes functions for creating image and audio messages, and handles compatibility with OpenAI-specific types.

classes.name: LLMSpecificMessage
classes.description: A container for a context message specific to a particular LLM service, enabling service-specific message types while maintaining compatibility with the universal format.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Manages conversation context for LLM interactions, including message history, multimedia content, tools, and tool choices. Provides methods for message manipulation and content creation.

methods.name: from_openai_context
methods.description: Creates a LLMContext from an OpenAILLMContext, deprecated for internal migration purposes.

methods.name: create_image_url_message
methods.description: Creates a message containing an image URL, with optional accompanying text.

methods.name: create_image_message
methods.description: Creates a message containing an image, encoding it as base64, either from raw bytes or an already encoded image.

methods.name: create_audio_message
methods.description: Creates a message containing audio data encoded in base64 from audio frames.

methods.name: get_messages_for_persistent_storage
methods.description: Returns messages suitable for storage; deprecated method.

methods.name: get_messages
methods.description: Returns the current message list, optionally filtered by LLM-specific messages.

methods.name: add_message
methods.description: Adds a single message to the context.

methods.name: add_messages
methods.description: Adds multiple messages to the context.

methods.name: set_messages
methods.description: Replaces all messages in the context.

methods.name: set_tools
methods.description: Sets the tools available for the LLM, validating the input.

methods.name: add_image_frame_message
methods.description: Adds a message containing an image frame, asynchronously.

methods.name: add_audio_frames_message
methods.description: Adds a message containing audio frames, asynchronously.

methods.name: _normalize_and_validate_tools
methods.description: Validates and normalizes the tools input, ensuring it is a ToolsSchema or raises an error.
